You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
{6} plus six
description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar and the Spark Double token trigger, creating two token copies of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting any Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
Orvar, Spark Double and the three Spark Double tokens trigger, creating five token copies of the Island.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the Island tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
Once you have infinite mana, you can then target any artifact, creature or land using Mind Games to get infinite tokens of them.
